visible_turns.text: That was a great dinner . I didn't know that you knew how yo cook .
I don't know . I'm pretty full . What are we having ?
Ooh , that's my favorite . Maybe I'll have a small slice .
I'll have a cup of tea .
Actually , could I have some milk with that ?
Skim , please . That'd be very nice . Thanks ... oh no . Janna , I'm so sorry , but I've got to go .
I just got a message from my sister saying that she's been in a car accident . I need to go pick her up .
She's on the M40 , near Reading .
I don't know , she didn't say . I'm so sorry about this .

batches.claim: B prepared or was involved in preparing the dinner that A praised
B cooked a dinner that A considered great.
B was expecting A to stay for the remainder of the evening (A apologizes for leaving abruptly)
B can provide or serve tea to A
Janna was hosting the dinner gathering
B asked A for more details about the sister's situation (A responds 'I don't know, she didn't say')
B cooked the dinner that A has just praised.
B suggested or mentioned a food item that is A's favorite
B was in a position to suggest or decide what food items to have (e.g., ordering or menu selection)
B is being asked to provide A with skim milk for a cup of tea.
B was present with A at the dinner location and was the person A was speaking to throughout the exchange
